items.html: Therefore now, since all are revealed, a complete Partzuf is made from the illumination of all the Hassadim, from Abba alone, and Yashsut is included with him. And from the illumination of all the Gevurot, a complete Partzuf is now made from Bina alone, and Tevuna is included with her. For all the Hassadim are now in one equivalence, and likewise all the Gevurot are now in one equivalence.
